# Reading FASTQ files {#sec-fastq}

A FASTQ record has four lines. See @fig-workflow for where this step fits.

![Overall workflow](../images/workflow.svg){#fig-workflow width=60%}

Count reads in a gzipped FASTQ file:

```bash
zcat sample_R1.fastq.gz | awk 'END {print NR/4}'
```

The same in Python:

```python
import gzip

with gzip.open("sample_R1.fastq.gz", "rt") as fh:
    n = sum(1 for _ in fh) // 4
print(n)
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Do not open large FASTQ files in Excel.
:::
